info.name: FootBot Player Headshots & Rosters
info.description: Postman Collection for querying FootBot's player headshot images, direct static assets, and team rosters containing SofaScore IDs.

item.name: Player Headshots
item.description: Endpoints resolving player photos dynamically using names, SofaScore IDs, filename matches, or custom role-based silhouettes.

query.description: Full name of the player to slugify and search (e.g. lionel_messi.jpg)

request.description: Queries the player image endpoint using the player's full name. The backend slugifies the name and returns the cached Wikipedia image if available.

query.description: SofaScore ID of the player (e.g. 826725 for Haaland)

request.description: Queries the player image endpoint using the player's unique SofaScore ID. The backend checks both predefined and dynamically cached rosters to resolve the image.

query.description: Direct file name with extension stored in frontend/assets/

request.description: Queries the player image endpoint using the direct filename. The endpoint validates the file extension and prevents directory traversal before returning the file response.
Demonstrates the dynamic role-based silhouette fallback for a Goalkeeper (GK) when a player's image is not found in assets, rosters, or Wikipedia caches.

query.description: DF, CB, LB, RB etc. return defender_avatar.svg fallback silhouette

request.description: Demonstrates the dynamic role-based silhouette fallback for a Defender (DF) when a player's image is not found.

query.description: MF, CM, DM, AM, LM, RM etc. return midfielder_avatar.svg fallback silhouette

request.description: Demonstrates the dynamic role-based silhouette fallback for a Midfielder (MF) when a player's image is not found.

query.description: FW, ST, LW, RW, CF return striker_avatar.svg fallback silhouette

request.description: Demonstrates the dynamic role-based silhouette fallback for a Forward/Striker (FW) when a player's image is not found.

item.name: Static Assets Mount
item.description: Endpoints directly accessing files mounted under /assets statically.

request.description: Accesses the static assets mount directly to download the file `lionel_messi.jpg`.
Accesses the static assets mount directly to download the file `haaland.png`.

item.name: Reference Data
item.description: Reference requests to extract data structure containing SofaScore IDs, names, positions, and photo paths.

query.description: Name of the club or national team

request.description: Fetches the full roster metadata for Manchester City from predefined store or LLM resolution, listing players along with their SofaScore IDs, positions, and local photo paths. Use these details to query player headshots.
